name: HaloDomeHouse_11
note: HouseB (26 x 18 x 28, wide/low). Low cottage body 20 x 14.5, one 9-stud storey, single arched door with lantern pedestals, an arched window each side of the door, flower planters left/right in front (two wide pots). No awning in the 2D. Roof in the 2D is a blue tiled HIP roof with a gold ridge finial and a chimney: the generator cannot make it, so the top is the closest flat roof with a solid gold-capped parapet. Missing: tiled hip roof, chimney, corbels under the eaves, climbing ivy / low curved planter walls (see generator_gaps.md). Built from art/review/img3/HaloDomeHouse_11_check.jpg (2D panel); the 2D PNG and side view are not in the worktree.
